note: Hamblen County park on Cherokee Lake; tent sites and water/electric RV sites, the lake-access ones along a cove. Public boat dock and marina in the park. --Claude
summary: Cherokee Park (Hamblen County) checked on the county's park page, Esri, 3DEP and Google: 85 sites (primitive + water/electric RV), $35 standard / $45 Prime Lake Access, $20 primitive, showers and dump stations; lakefront KEPT on the NE-edge RV row (~1.6 m above summer pool, ~15-20 m over an open riprap bank); stored pin is ~320 m off in the park field; long-term camping being phased out through 2027.
flags: WATERFRONT lakefront KEPT (checked hard). The RV row along the NE edge of the loop (~36.2590,-83.2732; the county's 'Prime Lake Access RV Hook-Up Sites', sold by the night at $45) sits at 329.1 m (3DEP) on an open riprap/grass bank with no trees between it and the cove. Lidar caught the lake at a winter level (319.3 m); Cherokee's normal 27-ft range puts summer pool at ~327.5 m (TVA's own figure was a 403, unread), i.e. pads ~1.6 m above the summer edge, ~15-20 m away over a gentle bank. The cove is ~60-80 m wide at summer pool, a lake arm, not a creek. Passes the kayak test. Site numbers are not published (no campground map on the county page), so the sites can be named only as the Prime Lake Access row.

PIN MOVE ~320 m: stored 36.26077,-83.27644 is the park's open field beside the pavilions (Esri); the campground is the RV cluster at ~36.2586,-83.2737 (Google's point 36.25863,-83.27405 is the loop entrance). Suggest location -> 36.2586,-83.2737 (3DEP ~328 m; stored elevation_meters 347 -> ~328).

LONG-STAY: the county says long-term camping (over 29 days on a site) 'has been discontinued for new campers and is being phased out through Dec. 2027' for those already in place; temporary workers may stay 90 days; weekly and monthly rates posted; decks allowed in the front campground. Autumn imagery shows ~35-40 RVs on site in autumn. Nightly share not measurable from the page (no site map or calendar). County-owned, so the private-park long-stay screen does not strictly apply; not a drop candidate on the page's wording, which sells daily sites first.

SEASON: stored year_round (note-derived) left alone. The page gives year-round park hours (8-10 Apr-Oct, 8-5 Nov-Mar) but also 'Off-Season RV Storage November-February', which may mean camping slows or stops in winter; not settled by the page.
PHONE 423-586-0325 confirmed ('Campground information'); Google lists 423-586-5232, which the county page gives as the pavilion line. No change.

WEBSITE: the county page carries injected spam text ('where can i buy diazepam online in usa' inside the amphitheatre paragraph); the page is otherwise the county's own and current. Worth knowing; no change.
